Fix the flow and $x$ as in Proposition 3. For $1<\ell <\infty $, let $\bar t$ be a surgery time of scale $\bar h$, and suppose $0<\tau _1\leq \ell ^{-1}\bar h^2$ contains no earlier surgery. A path beginning outside all $B(p_i,\bar t,(50+A_0)\bar h)$ and satisfying $\int _0^{\tau _1}|X_\gamma |^2\leq \ell $ is disjoint from $J(\bar t-\tau _1,\bar t)$.
Proof

\sketch The initial point is separated from the relevant neck boundary by order $\bar h$. Small surgery control keeps the neck metrics uniformly comparable during $\tau _1$. Entering $J$ therefore gives $\int |X_\gamma |>10\bar h$, and Cauchy–Schwarz gives $\int |X_\gamma |^2>\ell $.
